description: This file defines the DatatypeService interface in Java, which provides API methods related to handling custom datatypes and their handlers within the OpenMRS platform. It includes method signatures for retrieving datatypes, handlers, and ClobDatatypeStorage objects, as well as saving and deleting storage entries.

classes.name: DatatypeService
classes.description: Interface for datatype-related API methods in OpenMRS, extending OpenmrsService.

methods.name: getAllDatatypeClasses
methods.description: Returns all datatypes registered by core code and modules.

methods.name: getAllHandlerClasses
methods.description: Returns all handlers registered by core code and modules.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a CustomDatatype of the specified class with the given configuration, may throw CustomDatatypeException.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the default handler for a given CustomDatatype with the specified handler configuration.

methods.name: getHandlerClasses
methods.description: Returns a list of handler classes suitable for the given CustomDatatype class.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object by its ID.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorageByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object by its UUID.

methods.name: saveClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Creates or updates a ClobDatatypeStorage object in the database.

methods.name: deleteClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Deletes a ClobDatatypeStorage object from the database.
